regulationRef.description: ESPR 32024R1781 mandates no product data of its own. Art. 7(1) makes information requirements those 'laid down in the delegated acts adopted pursuant to Article 4'; Art. 9(2) says those acts 'shall … specify' what a passport carries; and Art. 27 binds manufacturers only 'when placing products COVERED BY a delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 4' on the market. All three defer to an Art. 4 act, and none is adopted for this category — so this field is anticipated, not required. Verified against the EUR-Lex text.

Art. 7(1) makes information requirements those 'laid down in the delegated acts adopted pursuant to Article 4'; Art. 9(2) says those acts 'shall … specify' what a passport carries; and Art. 27 binds manufacturers only 'when placing products COVERED BY a delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 4' on the market. regulationRef.description: ESPR 32024R1781 mandates no product data of its own. Art. 7(1) makes information requirements those 'laid down in the delegated acts adopted pursuant to Article 4'; Art. 9(2) says those acts 'shall … specify' what a passport carries; and Art. 27 binds manufacturers only 'when placing products COVERED BY a delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 4' on the market. All three defer to an Art. 4 act, and none is adopted for this category — so this field is anticipated, not required. Verified against the EUR-Lex text.
